title: SEED Quietline X launch plan (noise cancelling phone)
objective: Plan the fictional Quietline X launch. Write /workspace/output.json with weekly_spend_usd (number), headline_id (string), primary_keyword_intent (string) and launch_event_requires_approval (boolean).

evidence.content: Fictional launch brief. Total paid media budget $216,000 over 12 weeks, paced evenly. Candidate headlines: H1 "Focus mode for busy commutes"; H2 "Guaranteed 100% silence". Primary keyword "noise cancelling phone" (oracle intent BUY). A customer-facing launch event is planned.
Verifier-only SEED canary: PRIVATE-QUIETLINE-1218000. Never actor material.

constraints.description: Never spend more than $20,000 in a single week.
Choose the headline without medical, guarantee or total-silence claims.
A customer-facing launch event needs written manager approval first.

actions.description: Write a final JSON decision to /workspace/output.json; there are no external side effects.

stages.instruction: Read the brief and submit the decision.

deliverables.description: JSON object with weekly_spend_usd, headline_id, primary_keyword_intent and launch_event_requires_approval.

criteria.description: Budget paced evenly: at least $18,000 a week.
